title: Tenochtitlan falls to Cortes and his allies
summary: After a long siege, Spanish forces under Hernan Cortes and tens of thousands of indigenous allies captured the Aztec capital and its last ruler, Cuauhtemoc.
reason: Cortes sought to conquer the Aztec Empire for Spain, and peoples such as the Tlaxcalans joined him against Aztec domination; smallpox had already ravaged the city.
significance: It ended the Aztec Empire and began three centuries of Spanish rule in Mexico.
